svg.title: One meiosis, one ascus
svg.desc: Source image_009.jpg. A and a are alleles of one schematic homologous chromosome pair, not yeast mating types. Chromosome duplication precedes homolog segregation at meiosis I and sister segregation at meiosis II. Four chromatids enter four ascospores in one ascus. Schematic, not to scale. Original vector construction based on lecture source relationships.
